text:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to flip the `new-ranking` feature flag to 1% as a canary + run an A/B across the same traffic. Wanted to sync on audience split, metrics, and kill-switch procedure.

sam: +1. Are we doing randomized user-id bucketing or session-based?

maria: Use user-id hashing. session would be noisy for long-lived users.

jamie: For metrics, suggested primary: CTR on suggested completions. Secondary: latency p75 and error-rate (5xx). Also watch token cost per request.

reza: Agree on metrics. For stopping rules: if CTR delta < 0 and p-value < 0.05 after >1000 impressions OR 5xx rate increases by >0.5% absolute, pause rollout.

alex: Sounds good. Can we codify that into experiment config? I can add to the experiments repo once we settle wording.

sam: I'll create the flag in LaunchDarkly (key: `new-ranking.v1`) and set default OFF. Canary rule: user.hash % 100 < 1 => on. AB variant: A=control, B=rank-v1 same split.

maria: One more: ensure we exclude internal traffic and account for bots. We'll add allowlist false and filter characteristic for `internal=true`.

jamie: QA checklist: smoke on staging, then small prod traffic (0.1%), watch logs for ranking exceptions. If any exception > 2 in 10m, immediate rollback.

alex: Can someone post the toggle snippet we'll use in service? want to standardize.

sam: Snippet below — will add to the feature flag SDK helpers in repo: 

```js
// pseudo-code
const isNewRanking = flags.isOn('new-ranking.v1', { userId });
if (isNewRanking) {
  event.track('experiment.exposed', { experiment: 'new-ranking', variant: 'B' });
  useRankV1();
} else {
  useRankControl();
}
```

maria: For analytics: we'll tag exposures with `experiment_id` and `bucket_key`. data-bot, can you confirm event schema?

data-bot: schema OK. Required fields: user_id, experiment_id, variant, timestamp, bucket_key, request_id. Will validate in ingestion.

reza: SRE note: please add a kill endpoint reachable by the ops runbook that sets the flag to OFF globally and triggers an emergency rollback job. deploy-bot, can we wire that into the oncall flow?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary flip window 2026-03-20T15:00Z -> 2026-03-20T16:00Z. Emergency rollback: POST /ops/rollbacks/flags/new-ranking.v1 will set to OFF and notify #incidents.

jamie: Also add an automatic rollback if p75 latency increases >50ms vs baseline for 10 minutes. That should be in the rollout automation.

alex: I'll draft the experiment definition (audience, bucketing, metrics, thresholds, stop rules) and post PR against experiments/config. Expecting to link to a dashboard: `dashboards/exp/new-ranking-v1`.

maria: One ask: can we run the experiment with stratified sampling by country (US/EU/ROW) to ensure not regionally biased? 1% overall but ensure proportional representation.

sam: LD rule updated: user.hash % 100 < 1 AND region in [US, EU, AP] to start. We can expand after initial check.

alex: OK — action items: sam create flag + initial roll, maria add analytics tags + dashboard, jamie QA smoke + runbook, reza add kill endpoint wiring, alex PR for experiment config. I'll ping in 2h with the PR link. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks. One more tiny thing — add test harness to replay 10k historical sessions through ranking v1 to sanity-check score distribution before enabling.

sam: good call, will run overnight and post results.

alex: great. If nobody objects, I'll proceed with the experiment PR and the 1% canary next week.

jamie: No objections from me. :eyes:

deploy-bot: NOTE: reminder — ensure traffic filters updated to exclude internal CI and load-testing IP ranges before canary.

alex: closing loop: PR created at 1763605900, link in thread. sam — can you kick off the replay job?

sam: replay kicked off at 1763606201, ~10k sessions estimated, will post result summary.

data-bot: Replay results: mean score delta +0.02, stdev 0.12, no exceptions. (validated at 1763607000)

alex: excellent, thanks everyone. I'll merge experiment PR after 24h of replay stability checks.

jamie: Adding note to runbook: rehearse rollback once before full ramp.

alex: done.
